name: manual_8f76dc
claim: Treat a pending migration announcement as durable delivery work: retry it independently of topology changes and cached discovery returns, outside the broad discovery lock; a stable network is not evidence that a prior announcement was delivered.

decisions.notes: PR #459 review identified that topology-driven watch polling and cached returns could leave a failed migration pending indefinitely. The repair separates migration retry from endpoint discovery and verifies both a warm cached invocation and a stable watch tick.

rationale: PR #459 review identified that topology-driven watch polling and cached returns could leave a failed migration pending indefinitely. The repair separates migration retry from endpoint discovery and verifies both a warm cached invocation and a stable watch tick.
